description: The website's funnels (its own steps, else built from its goal, page types and conversion events): people reaching each step in the last 28 days and the 28 before, the share going on at each step, by device and channel, and where people went next. Says when the funnel report is unavailable. Another organization's or an unconnected site answers not found. Read-only.
name: webops_funnel_steps
title: Funnels: people at each step
